releaseNotes:
💌 Yearly wishes are now a shareable card — pick WhatsApp and send image + text together
🗓️ Wishes go out 7 days ahead (not 30), so they feel like a greeting not a sales nudge
💛 Lost enquiries that reached In Talks still get a yearly wish; corporate and open leads are skipped
📋 Event Types in Dropdown Manager stay visible; accidental Eng removed; App lead source restored
⚡ Faster location search, capitalised names, readable event type in pushes
features: NEW: Share a branded wish card (image + warm message) for birthdays and anniversaries
IMPROVED: Re-engagement lead time defaults to 7 days
IMPROVED: Wish-eligible lost enquiries can get a yearly occasion stamp and reminder
FIXED: Dropdown Manager Event Types list; App lead source available again
FASTER: Location / Maps search with warm-up and cache
bugFixes: Fixed Event Types going empty after a quick-add from the form
Fixed missing App lead source for most historical enquiries
Fixed wish messages that read like a sales pitch
Fixed corporate occasions getting a personal yearly wish
